steps.en: Another system can call OCMS to read offence notices
steps.id: Sistem lain bisa memanggil OCMS untuk membaca notice pelanggaran

steps.en: Caller can filter and page through notices
steps.id: Pemanggil bisa menyaring dan membaca notice per halaman
steps.why_en: Two copies of the lookup exist and the intranet one ignores some filters.
steps.why_id: Ada dua salinan pencarian dan salinan intranet mengabaikan sebagian filter.

steps.en: Response returns offence details like vehicle, stage, amount and payment
steps.id: Respons berisi detail pelanggaran seperti kendaraan, stage, jumlah dan pembayaran

steps.en: Caller can ask for suspension history with each notice
steps.id: Pemanggil bisa meminta riwayat suspension ikut dikirim

steps.en: Internet-side notices can be read by other systems
steps.id: Notice sisi internet bisa dibaca sistem lain
steps.why_en: The internet-side lookup returns fixed sample data, not real notices.
steps.why_id: Pencarian sisi internet hanya mengembalikan data contoh tetap, bukan notice asli.

steps.en: Other systems such as FOMS can fetch the same data
steps.id: Sistem lain seperti FOMS bisa mengambil data yang sama
steps.why_en: Only PLUS is named in the code; nothing identifies or supports FOMS.
steps.why_id: Hanya PLUS yang disebut di code; tidak ada yang mengenali atau mendukung FOMS.
